<a id="v1-8-1-english"></a>
### English

> Mobile session tabs now match the Back button's height. HTTPS forwarding to an HTTP backend can be allowed through a setting, with clearer sign-in guidance.

#### Important fixes

- Mobile session tabs are more compact and align with Back, while keeping the close button easy to tap.

#### Important additions

- Settings → Security and fnOS Application Settings can turn off HTTPS/HTTP origin protocol checking without entering a trusted proxy IP. Checking is enabled by default; domain, port and password checks remain active.
- Sign-in explains when protocol checking blocks a request and shows where to change it, instead of displaying only “Forbidden”.

**Full Changelog**: [v1.8.0...v1.8.1](https://github.com/zmide/Terma/compare/v1.8.0...v1.8.1)

<a id="v1-8-1-zh"></a>
### 简体中文

> 移动端会话标签与返回按钮高度一致，布局更加紧凑。新增允许 HTTPS 转发到 HTTP 后端的设置，登录受阻时会显示清楚的处理说明。

#### 重要修复

- 移动端会话标签缩小并与返回按钮对齐，关闭按钮仍保留方便点击的触控区域。

#### 重要新增

- Terma“设置 → 安全”和飞牛应用设置可关闭 HTTPS/HTTP 来源协议校验，无需填写可信代理 IP。默认开启，关闭后仍校验域名、端口和密码。
- 登录页会说明协议校验拦截的原因和设置入口，不再只显示“Forbidden”。

**完整变更**：[v1.8.0...v1.8.1](https://github.com/zmide/Terma/compare/v1.8.0...v1.8.1)
